description: Test suite for Leave Encashment functionality in ERPNext, including setup, leave balance validation, ledger entry creation, and cancellation handling.

classes.name: TestLeaveEncashment
classes.description: Unit test class for Leave Encashment features, including setup, validation, ledger creation, and cancellation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by clearing relevant tables, creating leave policy, employee, leave period, and salary structure.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up test environment by deleting test data from database tables.

methods.name: test_leave_balance_value_and_amount
methods.description: Validates leave balance, encashable days, and amount calculations, and checks link to additional salary.

methods.name: test_creation_of_leave_ledger_entry_on_submit
methods.description: Verifies that leave ledger entries are created upon leave encashment submission and are deleted upon cancellation.
